_note: S188 s188/ra-vfx — the Ra sky strike (the Pharaoh's ritual AND the player's POWER OF RA, one
drawer), built by scripts/build-light-sheet-atlas.mjs from the owner's 6x4 sheet on black.
Sheet frames, read in reading order: 1-4 the rune ring swelling, 5-6 the beam dropping (cut by
the cell TOP), 7-9 the beam landing in the ring, 10-12 the impact flash + cracks, 13-14 the
debris explosion, 15-19 the mushroom cloud, 21-24 fire / smoke / embers fading.
DROPPED: frame 20 (row 4 col 2) — a full beam again, out of sequence between the mushroom cloud
(19) and the dying fire (21). Dropped, not held or interpolated: 23 frames ship.
groundY is the IMPACT LINE per SOURCE ROW, sheet-absolute. Measured S188 on the rings: row 1
ring centre 149, row 2 ring centre 163 (+212 origin), rows 3-4 crater / crack origin 172 (+425,
+638 origins). groundGuard re-measures the clean rings (1-4, 7-9) at build time and FAILS if the
declared line is more than tolPx off. Rows 3-4 have no clean ring; their line was read off the
crater and the crack origin by eye on a crosshair overlay.
frameTicks + impactFrame are THE TIMELINE and are pinned by src/render/raStrikeArt.test.ts
against RA_STRIKE_FRAME_TICKS / RA_STRIKE_IMPACT_FRAME. The nine frames before the impact sum to
exactly RA_COLUMN_TICKS (120 = the 2 s telegraph window), so the ring appears on the very tick
the column is announced and the flash (sheet frame 10) plays ON the impact tick.
name: ra-strike
